semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides precision flow measurement and control solutions that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Bronkhorst (Shanghai) Instrumentation Trading Co., ltd specializes in precision instruments for mass flow measurement and control, including gas and liquid mass flow meters/controllers and pressure gauges/controllers. Their products are essential for ensuring accuracy and repeatability in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
capabilities: Gas and liquid mass flow meters/controllers
Customized flow control solutions for OEMs

regional_presence.China: Bronkhorst operates in China through its Shanghai-based entity, focusing on sales and support for precision flow control solutions.
